claim: On January 31, 2023 the ElastiCache for Redis Multi-AZ SLA changed: previously ElastiCache for Redis offered an SLA of 99.9% for Multi-AZ configurations. Node-based Redis OSS and Valkey deployments in a Multi-AZ configuration are now eligible for the 99.99% availability SLA.
question: When did the ElastiCache for Redis Multi-AZ SLA rise to 99.99%, and what was it before?

values.spoken: an availability SLA of ninety-nine point nine nine percent
an SLA of ninety-nine point nine percent for Multi-AZ

qualifiers.scope: ElastiCache Multi-AZ configurations (Redis OSS and Valkey, node-based)
qualifiers.condition: the What's New post is dated 2023-01-31

evidence.quote: Previously, ElastiCache for Redis offered an SLA of 99.9% for Multi-AZ configurations.
When running ElastiCache in a Multi-AZ configuration for node-based Redis OSS and Valkey deployments, your caches are eligible for the 99.99% availability SLA.

changed.was: an SLA of 99.9% for Multi-AZ configurations

note: The What's New post, dated 2023-01-31, announces 99.99% for ElastiCache for Redis Multi-AZ; its first sentence cannot be quoted because the snapshot is one JSON line. Current truth for the 99.99% value is the FAQ sentence and the deployment options page. Older material and older exam questions may say 99.9%.
